origin.says: From 螢: 虫 (insect) for the meaning plus the top of 熒 (glowing) as the sound: the glowing insect. The simplified form writes the double-fire top as 艹 (grass) over 冖 (cover).

乾.def: arid, dry; to fertilize; to penetrate; heavenly generative principle (male)

ety.hint: Rays 十 emanating from the 日; 乞 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 倝 (sun rising, here the left side with the person-shaped top of the right) as the sound plus 乙 (bent sprout), whose role is unclear: to be dry, also heaven. The modern shape reads the right side as 乞 (beg).

乾.name: heaven dry

origin.says: 彡 (brush strokes, ornament) for the meaning plus 林 (grove) as the sound: ornate and refined. One reading takes the sound part as a shortened 焚 (burn) instead.

梭.def: a weaver's shuttle; to go back and forth

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 夋 (a walking figure) as the sound: the wooden shuttle of a loom that darts back and forth.

梭.name: shuttle

origin.says: 皿 (vessel, bowl) for the meaning plus 灰 (ash) as the sound: a bowl-shaped thing, a basin, and a helmet shaped like an upturned bowl.

匾.def: a board, sign, or tablet made from bamboo

ety.hint: A board 扁 made of bamboo 匸; 扁 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扁 (flat board) for both meaning and sound, inside 匚 (box frame): a flat inscribed board hung over a door.

匾.name: name board

origin.says: Simplified from 顱: 盧 (pot), now 卢, as the sound plus 页 (head) for the meaning: the round pot of the head, the skull.

彪.def: tiger; a tiger's stripes; like a tiger

ety.hint: A tiger's 虎 stripes 彡

origin.says: 虎 (tiger) beside 彡 (stripes, hair lines): a tiger's stripes, a tiger; hence strong and imposing.

彪.name: tiger stripes

origin.says: 口 (mouth) marks a sound word, with 拍 (clap) as the sound: a bang or smack.

ety.hint: Two hands 日, 又 pulling an eye open 罒

origin.says: A hand 又 (hand) lifting a covering (now the 日-like top) off an eye (the 罒 (eye) in the middle), so the eye can gaze far: long, stretched out, vast. The covering is no longer visible as such.
日 (sun) for the meaning plus 每 (every) as the sound: the last day of the lunar month with no moonlight, dark, obscure.
足 (foot) for the meaning plus 止 (foot) as the sound: the toe. 止 alone first meant foot; the foot sign was added once 止 came to mean 'stop'.
口 (mouth) plus 虎 (tiger), the sound: a tiger's roar, now to bluff, to scare someone.
阝 (town, on the right) for the meaning plus 咢 (shouting) as the sound: the name of an old state, now short for Hubei province.
山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 奇 (strange) as the sound: rough, rugged mountain ground.

ety.hint: A bird 隹 faced with a mountain 山

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) as the sound: high and towering; also a surname.
巾 (cloth) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) as the sound: a hanging curtain or tent wall.
钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 考 (to test; old age) as the sound: metal shackles. Simplified from 銬 by shortening the metal part 釒 to 钅.
钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 当 (serve as) as the sound: a metal pan, also a clanging sound. Simplified from 鐺.

矫.def: to correct, to rectify, to straighten out

origin.says: Simplified from 矯: 矢 (arrow) for the meaning plus 乔 (tall) as the sound: to straighten like an arrow shaft, to correct.

矫.name: straighten

origin.says: 禾 (grain plant) for the meaning plus 吉 (lucky) as the sound: the stalks of grain after threshing. It stands for the more complex 稭.

ety.hint: To use an ox 牛 to harvest 刂 grain 禾; 利 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 利 (sharp, reaping) as the sound plus 牛 (ox) for the meaning: the ox-drawn blade that cuts the soil, 'plow'.
From 穢: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 歲 (year) as the sound: weeds among the grain, so dirty, foul. 歲 became 岁.
𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 生 (life) as the sound: the mouth organ made of bamboo pipes.

偎.def: to cling to, to cuddle, to embrace, to fondle

ety.hint: To cling to someone 亻 in fear 畏; 畏 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 畏 (dread) as the sound: to snuggle up to someone.

偎.name: cuddle

origin.says: 舟 (boat) for the meaning plus 它 (snake, it) as the sound: the rudder or helm of a boat. A late character.
攵 (a hand with a stick, action) for the meaning plus 佥 (all) as the sound: to gather in, to collect by force. Simplified from 斂 by shortening 僉 to 佥.
月 (here flesh, meat) for the meaning plus 甫 (just now) as the sound: dried meat, later also dried fruit.

ety.hint: A pig 豕 suckling at its mother's teat ⺼

origin.says: ⺼ (meat) plus 豕 (pig): a pig raised for meat, a young suckling pig.

逸.def: to flee, to escape, to break loose

ety.hint: To run 辶 like a rabbit 兔

origin.says: A rabbit 兔 (rabbit) with 辶 (walk): a rabbit running off, to escape, to flee, hence also ease and leisure. Oracle bones wrote it with other parts.

逸.name: runaway

ety.hint: Many people 灬 (twenty or more 廿) in a house 广

origin.says: 石 (stone) as the sound and meaning plus 火 (fire, now 灬) below: a stone pot over a fire, to cook (later 煮). The meaning 'numerous, common people' is a loan; the stone wore into 广 + 廿.

ety.hint: A building 广 where people remain 奄; 奄 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 广 (building) for the meaning plus 奄 (to cover) as the sound: a small hut, later a Buddhist nunnery.
From 閻: 門 (gate), shortened to 门, for the meaning plus 臽 (pit) as the sound: the gate of a village lane; now mostly a surname and Yama, king of the underworld.
羊 (sheep) for the meaning plus 令 (command) as the sound: the antelope, a sheep-like animal.
火 (fire) for the meaning plus 旱 (drought) as the sound: to join metal with heat, to weld.
火 (fire) for the meaning plus 奂 (grand) as the sound: shining like a fire. Simplified from 煥, whose sound part 奐 became 奂.

鸿.def: a species of wild swan; vast

origin.says: 江 (big river) as the sound plus 鸟 (bird) for the meaning: the wild swan; then vast. Simplified from 鴻, with 鳥 (bird) in short form.

鸿.name: wild swan

淌.def: to trickle down, to flow, to drip; to shed tears

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 尚 (esteem) as the sound: water flowing, dripping, tears running.

淌.name: flow down

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) as the sound: the Huai River.

淤.def: mud, sediment; to clog up, to silt up

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 於 (at) as the sound: silt that water leaves behind, mud that clogs.

淤.name: silt

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 卒 (soldier) as the sound: worn out with grief, haggard.

寅.def: to respect, to revere; respectfully; 3rd terrestrial branch

origin.says: First an arrow (矢 (arrow)) with a mark, later with hands; the arrowhead turned into 宀 (roof) and the mark into a 由-like box. Borrowed as the third earthly branch (the tiger).

寅.name: tiger branch

origin.says: 穴 (cave, hole) for the meaning plus 至 (arrive) as the sound: a hole that is stopped up, to block or choke.

ety.hint: An oven 穴 where pots 缶 are fired; 缶 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 穴 (cave, hole) for the meaning, a pit used for firing pottery. The older form 窯 used 羔 (lamb) as the sound; this variant has 缶 (clay pot), which points to the pottery fired in it.
Probably a person (尸, body), a hand (寸) and fire, the fire now merged into 示 (altar) by shape: a hand pressing a heated iron, the original of 熨 (to iron). The officer's title is a later sense.
A shortened 隓 (to fall, crumble; 阝 with 左) as the sound plus ⺼ (meat): first leftover meat offerings. The first Sui emperor took it from 隨 (to follow) for his dynasty's name.
阝 (mound, hill) for the meaning plus 禺 (monkey-like creature) as the sound: a bend or corner of a hill or wall, a nook.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 宛 (winding) as the sound: gentle and graceful, tactful in speech.

绽.def: to crack; to burst open; to split at the seams

origin.says: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 定 (settle) as the sound: a seam splitting, then bursting open like a flower. Simplified from 綻, with 糸 (silk) in short form.

绽.name: burst seam

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 林 (grove) as the sound: a beautiful gemstone.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 匽 (to hide away) as the sound: an earth bank holding back water, a dam.

揩.def: to wipe, to rub, to dust, to clean

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 皆 (all) as the sound: to wipe or rub clean with the hand.

揩.name: rub clean

彭.def: name of an ancient country; surname

ety.hint: The sound 彡 of drums 壴

origin.says: 壴 (a drum on a stand) plus 彡 (strokes showing sound): the boom of drums. Now mostly a surname. One reading takes 彡 as the sound part.

彭.name: drumbeat

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 秋 (autumn) as the sound: to grab with the fingers, to pinch.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 胡 (reckless) as the sound: the bottle gourd.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 郎 (young man) as the sound: used in the name of the betel-nut palm.

酉 (wine jar, fermented things) for the meaning plus 禾 (grain), a shortened 穌 (revive), as the sound: a fermented milk fat, butter, and then crisp, flaky pastry. One source reads the roles the other way round.
尚 (esteem) as the sound plus 木 (tree) for the meaning: a crabapple or wild pear tree.

睐.def: to squint at; a sidelong glance

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 来 (come) as the sound: a sidelong glance. Simplified from 睞.

睐.name: sidelong glance

ety.hint: A cauldron on its bronze tripod

origin.says: A picture of a bronze cauldron with two handles and three legs, used for cooking and sacrifices.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 查 (check) as the sound: a sound word for chattering or whispering.
𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 皮 (skin) as the sound: lame, limping.
虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 廷 (court) as the sound: in 蜻蜓 (dragonfly).
虫 (creature) for the meaning plus 延 (stretch out) as the sound, which also hints at a long, stretched body: the millipede, and winding like one.
虫 (small creature) for the meaning plus 合 (join) as the sound, which also fits the two shells closing together: the clam.

啼.def: to weep, to whimper; to howl; to crow

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 帝 (emperor) as the sound: to cry, howl, or crow.

啼.name: wail

赐.def: to give; to bestow a favor; to appoint

origin.says: Simplified from 賜: 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 易 (easy) as the sound: to give valuables, to bestow. 貝 became its cursive shape 贝.

赐.name: grant

origin.says: From 鋅: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 辛 (bitter) as the sound, chosen for the metal zinc. The simplified form uses the short metal sign 钅.
生 (to give birth) as the sound plus 男 (male): a sister's child, first said of a man's sister's son; now nephew or niece.
气 (gas) for the meaning plus 录 (a form of 彔, short for 绿 green) as sound and hint: chlorine, the 'green gas'. A 19th-century coinage.
